mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods do not exceed baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS shows no sustained decline over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a monetary tightening cycle, raising long-term interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% for 30 consecutive days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward momentum in GDP demand (GDPC1) and downward movement in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a favorable macroeconomic environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when proxies exhibit the described interaction.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous peaks in GDP demand (GDPC1) and labor participation (PAYEMS) signal approaching saturation, leading to reduced growth expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and PAYEMS both rising above 10% month-over-month
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain positive despite both proxies exceeding their 10% MoM thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 4% indicates low labor market friction, fostering wage growth and demand expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when UNRATE shows sustained upward trend without other macro factors.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trajectory in the industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects robust supply chain activity, lowering inflationary pressures and enhancing investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when INDPRO shows sustained upward movement without corresponding monetary easing.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation spike in the CPIAUCSL index above 220 signals aggressive price increases, prompting central banks to raise interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 220 for 30 consecutive days.

mechanism_narrative: Strong demand growth (RSAFS) coupled with a decline in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a favorable macroeconomic environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when proxies exhibit the described interaction.
